name: 白頂玄燕鷗
illustrationTaxon: Adult brown noddy, sex unspecified; chocolate-brown body, pale grey-white forehead and crown fading into brown nape, white orbital ring. Corrected whole bird has a pointed closed tail.

similarSpecies.distinction: 玄燕鷗更深色、更細小，嘴較長而纖細；靜止時翼長過尾。素材有岩石底座，非比例對照。
烏燕鷗成鳥深色上體配白色下體、黑頂白額；本種褐色下體及灰白頭頂。

featureNotes: 近景頭頂淡色漸變至褐後頸。
修正全鳥素材中的黑嘴與嘴尖可見；不同於近景素材。
近景眼及白色眼圈可見。
近景翼上覆羽局部，畫面較抽象；不描述翼尾相對長度。

rangeMap.note: Partial native countries: HKBWS names Hawaii and Easter Island breeding, and ABC plus seahistory reports Australian breeding islands. Island breeding does not imply mainland distribution.

sources.use: Substantive read: 40–45 cm, dark chocolate plumage with grey-white forecrown, wedge tail; pale crown merges to brown nape, orbital ring white, relatively thicker bill and wings shorter than tail vs Black Noddy; HK accidental 2006/2020/2021; tropical island breeding, LC globally stable.
Black Noddy is smaller, darker, slender longer bill, wings longer than tail at rest.
Sooty Tern adult dark upperparts, white forehead, pale underparts.
Brown noddy nests on islands off Australia, among others.
